title: Miguel de Icaza comments on AI code fixes
author: eduo
selftext:
It’s an interesting post on how AI coding has been entering open source projects. I particularly like the part about provenance policies. 

https://tirania.org/blog/archive/2026/Nov-20.html

comments.author: sunnystormy64
comments.body: "Good fixes stay locked to private forks." - This line applies to the emerging AI gamedev space as well. Plenty of gamedevs (including myself) are not disclosing anything because we'd rather cook than seek attention.
